label: TP
reason: Alert 1 ('java/insecure-randomness') is TP because the insecure randomness source (nextInt) is used to generate 'rememberMeKey' which is then stored in a cookie. Alert 2 ('java/xss') is also TP because user-provided data from cookies is directly concatenated into HTML output without proper encoding. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source 'nextInt(...)' is used to create 'rememberMeKey' without cryptographic strength
User-provided cookie values are directly concatenated into HTML response without XSS encoding
